AvailabilityMatrixNotes: DISCONTINUED secondary market / eBay / used sets only
IntelligenceSummary: UST ProForce Rv2 Gold 75 Iron R (0.370" parallel tip for component/custom builds): Mid launch graphite iron shaft. CONFIRMED as a dedicated iron shaft NOT a wood shaft. Discontinued per UST Mamiya website. 'Rv2' = second revision of the original ProForce Gold iron shaft. Available in both 0.370" parallel (standard component builds) and 0.355" taper (OEM reshaft, special order). ~75g uncut; mid launch profile; high modulus carbon fiber construction same as original Gold series. OEM stock: found as stock in early-2000s Ping G2 HL, TaylorMade RAC CGB, Nike irons. For D0 swingweight build: graphite iron shaft at ~75g will typically produce lighter swingweight than steel expect to need tip weighting (2-4g) or longer butt length to reach D0 depending on Yamaha head weight (~198g). Verify head weights before building.
